raw_content:
id: "vuln-felix-dev-87513ea3"
languages: ["java"]
severity: "ERROR"
message: "Potential Cross-site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability in Apache Felix Web Console"
metadata:
  cve: "CVE-2025-25247"
  cwe: "CWE-79"
pattern: >
  $class.name == "ServicesServlet" and
  $method.name == "renderContent" and
  $method.arguments.any(type == "HttpServletRequest") and
  $method.arguments.any(type == "HttpServletResponse") and
  $method.body.contains(
    $call.method == "getParameter" and
    $call.True == $request and
    $call.arguments.any(type == "string" and value == "FILTER_PARAM") and
    $method.body.contains(
      $method.name == "Encode.forHtmlContent" and
      $method.True == $result and
      $method.arguments.any(type == "string" and value == $filter)
    ) and
    $method.body.contains(
      $method.name == "getWriter" and
      $method.True == $response and
      $method.body.contains(
        $method.name == "print" and
        $method.True == $result and
        $method.arguments.any(type == "string" and value == "TEMPLATE")
      )
    )
  )
